text: I need a budget hotel in New York that is clean and safe, without cockroaches, roaches, or dirty bathrooms.
I need a Manhattan hotel with clean bathrooms, without mildew or pubic hair in the bathroom.
I need a hotel for sleep that is quiet, without loud noise, door slamming, or noisy hallways.
I need a business hotel with reliable internet and WiFi, not a place where the Internet is down or the WiFi does not work.
I need a business hotel with computers and printers that work, not one with computers not working or an occupied business center.
I need a clean hotel with no roaches or cockroaches, where the rooms are immaculate and spotless.
I need a spacious suite for a family, not a tiny, cramped, or very small room.
I need helpful and polite hotel staff, not rude or unprofessional front desk service.
I need a hotel with free breakfast included, not one that charges ten dollars or has a breakfast surcharge.
I need a hotel with free parking, not an expensive parking charge or high daily parking fee.
I need a clean modern business hotel with good maintenance, not broken shower doors, sharp furniture, or shabby construction.
I need a hotel with a good breakfast, not a limited or awful breakfast experience.
I need a clean affordable Manhattan hotel without shared-bathroom problems, dirty shared bathrooms, or long waits for bathrooms.
I need a hotel with fast, stable WiFi in the room, not spotty WiFi or no wireless internet.
I need a hotel with friendly service, not security staring into my room or curt front desk behavior.
I need a quiet place for a weekend, not a hotel full of teenagers, slamming doors, or loud parents in hallways.
I need a hotel with a spacious dining or breakfast area, not a cramped and crowded breakfast area.
I need a hotel with working facilities and no broken room fixtures or low-quality shower doors.
I need a clean hotel without filthy tables, dirty bathrooms, or pubic hair.
I need a hotel with airport shuttle service, not a place where airport transportation fails or the arranged car service does not show up.
